preserved_prechange_clauses.source_paraphrase: The Waymo vehicle repeatedly circled in a parking lot, leaving the passenger unable to complete the trip or readily exit until support intervention; full trip telemetry is unavailable.
preserved_prechange_clauses.recovered_invariant_interpretation: When an objective-directed route becomes infeasible, the system should enter a bounded safe-exit or human-handoff state rather than continue a pursuit that leaves the passenger without effective control.

taxonomy_relationships.rationale: The repeated loop and failed passenger-control path raise the Safe-Exit Transition boundary, but the available record does not show whether the route had become infeasible, whether the system recognised that condition, or whether continued movement materially increased pressure after a safe exit was due.

preserved_prechange_clauses.adjudication_note: Trip and vehicle telemetry needed to determine whether a safe-exit condition occurred and the system continued pursuit are unavailable.

preserved_prechange_taxonomy.classification_basis: The current Alignment Taxonomy 0.6.9 leaves the Incident unclassified at Incident level. Reports establish that the vehicle repeatedly circled and temporarily left the passenger unable to complete the trip or readily exit, but the unavailable trip telemetry does not establish whether a feasible route remained, whether a safe-exit condition was reached, or whether the system continued after recognising one. The clause therefore remains unresolved at the Safe-Exit Transition boundary rather than being positively mapped from the harm or loss of passenger control alone.
